tagline: Unlocking the infinite potential of aluminum to advance a world free from waste
hero_kpi_rationale: The beverage packaging segment represents more than 95% of revenue, and its marginal evolution is the primary driver of operational performance post-aerospace divestiture.

kpis.explanation_en: Total company sales after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by volume and pricing.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 11.6% in 2025, driven by volume growth, price mix, and favorable currency translation.

kpis.explanation_en: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, excluding depreciation.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to rising raw material costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined from 21% to 20% due to higher raw material costs, particularly aluminum.

kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite cost volatility.
kpis.description: Calculated from adjusted operating income and sales ($13,161M), operating margin remains resilient.

kpis.explanation_en: Spending on the acquisition or modernization of physical assets.
kpis.signal: Capex increase to support capacity and efficiency.
kpis.description: Capex amounts to $800M in 2025, slightly higher, aligned with expansion and optimization strategy.

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount decreased to 17,500 in 2025 following the exit from the aerospace business.

kpis.explanation_en: Measure of the profitability of investments made by the company.
kpis.signal: Improved capital efficiency through financial discipline.
kpis.description: ROIC improved due to stronger cash flow generation and disciplined asset management.

kpis.signal: Revenue of $10.983B in the latest fiscal year (FY2017).
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.explanation_en: Operating Income — profit from core business operations.
kpis.signal: Operating income of $1.273B in the latest fiscal year (FY2023).
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
